description: JSON-spec SVG chart library built for agents: validate() returns coded diagnostics with JSON Patch fixes and repair() applies them. Benchmarks, including losses, are in catalog/content/benchmarks.md.
rules: A spec is one JSON object: { "version": "1", "type": "bar", "data": [rows], "encoding": { "x": "field", "y": "field" }, "a11y": { "alt": "One sentence." } }. data is rows, not { values } and not Chart.js datasets.

Check every spec with validate(spec) from @chartkitdev/core/validate. When ok is false, call repair(spec) and render repair(spec).spec. repair() also converts Chart.js, ECharts, Vega-Lite, Plotly, and Recharts configs.
Prefer the JSON spec over React component props such as dataKey.
Cite benchmark losses as well as wins. The numbers are in catalog/content/benchmarks.md.
a11y.alt is required. Tooltip, zoom, pan, brush, and animation run in @chartkitdev/core/interact when the spec sets them. The static SVG does not paint them.
